## Hypothesis

The VWAP overnight grinder identified a parameter combination that captures edge on non-J days and gains on J loser days, but fails to capture the large winner days (4/29 and 5/04) that drive the OP-16 edge_capture threshold. The edge is likely not genuine for the J anchor days due to poor performance on 2/3 winner days (edge_capture=40.01 UNVERIFIED-BY-CONSTRUCTION, wide_pnl=587.72 UNVERIFIED-BY-CONSTRUCTION, WR=0.833 UNVERIFIED-BY-CONSTRUCTION).

## Mechanism

Enter on VWAP reclaim or rejection signals with the following parameters: vol_mult=1.5, proximity_dollars=0.15, lookback_bars=2, body_min_cents=0.05, premium_stop_pct=-0.14, tp1_premium_pct=0.5, runner_target_pct=2.0, strike_offset=2, qty=3, tp1_qty_fraction=0.667, profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.1, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05, require_ribbon_agreement=true, ribbon_min_spread_cents=30.0. Exit at TP1 (+50% premium) for 2/3 of position, then trail the runner with breakeven stop after TP1, and exit on ribbon re-entry or time stop.
